These point extractors operate on the admitted native registered-family composition route, and live all-family canaries return finite `B_lv_unit`. Raw axis `alpha` and `Lambda` remain orientation-dependent and are not cross-fit targets. Wald calibration remains limited to the previously certified Gaussian, binomial, and eight named Gaussian-anchor cells; arbitrary-composition intervals, factor intervals, non-Gaussian masks, Julia calibration, and structured-tier parity remain partial. **2026-10-18 loading-ridge addendum:** `docs/dev-log/research/2026-10-18-loading-ridge-comparison/` retains the completed 24,000-fit fixed-truth native-Laplace comparison: 500 datasets per family/n/loading-scale cell, paired Inf/1/2/4, induced trait-effect coverage with available-interval and all-attempt denominators. Ridge 2 improves observed point recovery modestly but gives 66 unavailable-interval fits versus 64 for Inf across 6,000 attempts each; no general coverage or Hessian benefit. Keep this row partial: rank-two grouped-probit/replicated-Gaussian/replicated-Poisson evidence does not certify arbitrary compositions, score intervals, intercept-only ordination, or general 95% coverage. The effective unpenalised default is retained by maintainer decision. |
